certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Money and Time Basics (Ages 5-7)

learning_outcomes.text: Recognise common coins and their values
Add a small number of coins to find a total
Work out simple change from a small amount
Read o'clock and half past on a clock face
Name the days of the week and months in order
Order events in a day using before, after and next

integrative_case: Play shopkeeper and customer at a classroom stall: price items in coins, add up what a customer buys, give the right change, and note the time each 'shop' opens and closes using o'clock and half past.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
